1.title: Build the engine room
1.body: The logic, data and plumbing every screen quietly leans on — kept tidy as it grows.

2.title: Write rules that can’t bend
2.body: When the rules live on-chain there are no take-backs, so they get written slowly and read twice.

3.title: Keep everyone in sync
3.body: A change on one screen should show up on every other one, right away, for everyone.

4.title: Make waiting disappear
4.body: Measure, trim, rethink — until loading stops being part of the experience.

5.title: Lock the doors
5.body: Careful code, real authentication and encryption, so the only people inside are the invited ones.
